label: L1 — Bali 7-Day Plan
message:
First time in Bali? Here's your 7-day plan.

Day 1-2: Ubud — Tegallalang rice terraces at 7am (before the crowds), lunch at Locavore (book 2 weeks ahead), afternoon at Tirta Empul water temple.

Day 3-4: Canggu — sunrise surf lesson at Batu Bolong, brunch at Milk & Madu, sunset at La Brisa beach bar.

Day 5-7: Nusa Penida — Kelingking Beach viewpoint (go left at the fork for the uncrowded angle), snorkel with mantas at Manta Bay, finish at Diamond Beach.

Budget breakdown. Photo spots with GPS. Booking links.
All in one dashboard.

See the full plan: tripva.app

label: L2 — Tokyo 5-Day Plan
message:
Tokyo in 5 days — temple to ramen to Shibuya.

Day 1: Senso-ji at dawn (basically empty before 7am), then Nakamise-dori for street snacks. Evening in Golden Gai — Bar Albatross for the views.

Day 2-3: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast, Teamlab Borderless, then Shibuya Crossing at dusk — shoot from the Starbucks window, 2nd floor.

Day 4-5: Day trip to Kamakura for the Great Buddha, back for Shinjuku Omoide Yokocho.

Every spot mapped. Every meal planned. Budget per day.

See the full plan: tripva.app

label: L3 — Paris Hidden Gems
message:
Paris beyond the Eiffel Tower — the spots tourists miss.

Skip the Champs-Elysees. Seriously.

Instead: morning pastries at Du Pain et des Idees. Walk Canal Saint-Martin. Lunch at Chez Janou — order the chocolate mousse, it comes in a giant bowl.

Afternoon: Musee de l'Orangerie. Golden hour at Pont Alexandre III — face north for the best light.

Evening: wine at Le Baron Rouge near Bastille. Locals only. No English menu. That's how you know.

See the full plan: tripva.app

label: L5 — Iceland Ring Road
message:
Ring Road in 7 days — every stop, every budget line.

Day 1-2: Golden Circle, but skip Gullfoss restaurant (overpriced). Secret Lagoon in Fludir > Blue Lagoon (half the price, tenth the crowd).

Day 3-4: South Coast — Skogafoss at 6am, walk behind Seljalandsfoss (bring a rain jacket). Diamond Beach for the ice chunks on black sand.

Day 5-7: East Fjords to North — Studlagil Canyon (2km hike, worth every step). Myvatn Nature Baths. Whale watching from Husavik, not Reykjavik.

See the full plan: tripva.app

label: L6 — Barcelona Food Plan
message:
Pintxos for under 2 euros — our Barcelona food plan.

Forget the restaurants on La Rambla. Tourist prices, tourist food.

Breakfast: La Boqueria market — walk past the first 5 stalls. Head to El Quim de la Boqueria for the fried eggs with baby squid. €4.50.

Lunch: pintxos crawl in Poble Sec — Quimet & Quimet, then Bodega 1900 for the McFoie burger. Both under €15/person.

Dinner: Can Paixano — cava and tapas. Average bill: €8/person.

Total daily food budget: €27-35/person.

See the full plan: tripva.app
